text_block_list.text:
When I finished training
with Mejiro Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Is time up already!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, then that wraps things up for today.
Good work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No, well...
It's not really a big deal, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I ran a ton, it's like my body is itching to move?
Like, I just wanna run even more?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it.
If we overdo it, it'll mess up the schedule, right?
For now, let's call it a day—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyyy-yaaaaay☆☆☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The vibes are seriously insane!
Our party night has only just begun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios, I thought you just finished racing,
but your hype hasn't died down at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, sounds just like Helios.
Like, 'if you're hyped up, just go run!' kind of vibe."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...Well, but hey. Could something like that... maybe work for me too?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...Well, but hey. Could something like that... maybe work for me too?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wanna do it? For real, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna run with high spirits
just like Helios, not letting her beat me!
Which means...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get hyped together!
Way to go☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Start!

And so, the evening track—thinning of crowds—
was engulfed in an extraordinary fervor by the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, normally speaking, that makes sense.
No choice, guess Palmer-san will go with the theoretical approach today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, what would be good to blow off steam instead? Maybe going out to have some fun somewhere?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Then isn't this the part where the Trainer who brought it up tags along with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, no worries, curfew's coming up soon anyway so it won't take long!
It'll be quick, but let's have a blast!

And so, even if just for a short while,
I went into town to hang out with Mejiro Palmer,
and we had a great time.
